name: agentic
description: Eight independent Claude Code plugins — readability (MCP server), omlx (local inference MCP server), rm (reMarkable), md (Markdown-Viewer), zai (GLM usage), tokens (local token usage), statusline (status line + agent panel), todo (work tracking).

plugins.name: readability
plugins.description: Read a live URL to clean Markdown via the readability MCP server.

plugins.name: omlx
plugins.description: Delegate bulk work to a local omlx inference server.

plugins.name: rm
plugins.description: Beam the last reply to a reMarkable as EPUB.

plugins.name: md
plugins.description: Send the last reply to a Markdown-Viewer as a #share= URL.

plugins.name: zai
plugins.description: Query GLM Coding Plan quota and usage.

plugins.name: tokens
plugins.description: Per-model token usage and cache hit rate from local transcripts.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Render the status line and agent-panel rows from a component library of pickable designs.

plugins.name: todo
plugins.description: Work tracking — the rules plus six verbs (init, new, run, status, audit, handoff) over TODO.md, progress/, references/, archive/.
